gia_benefits.name: Skills pathway referral
gia_benefits.support: Potential linkage to approved skilling pathway subject to current GIA guidelines and local sanction.
gia_benefits.verification: Confirm current eligibility, funding and training-provider empanelment with district implementation authority.

gia_benefits.name: Toolkit / equipment pathway
gia_benefits.support: Potential toolkit or productive-asset pathway for an approved livelihood plan; amount is not represented as guaranteed.
gia_benefits.verification: Scheme terms, ceiling and beneficiary contribution must be verified locally.

gia_benefits.name: Enterprise enablement referral
gia_benefits.support: Potential referral for enterprise planning, group linkage or converged credit support as locally available.
gia_benefits.verification: Subject to current PM-AJAY GIA norms, appraisal and sanction.

gia_benefits.name: Training participation support
gia_benefits.support: Ask the district team about locally available travel, wage-loss or participation support.
gia_benefits.verification: No benefit amount is promised in this prototype.
